about: PRIVATE recorded range suite. One explicit grid for desktop and phone.

blocks.intro: Measure your own comfortable range first.

cells.cue: LOWEST comfortable hum; do not strain · hold about 2 s
HOME note; a relaxed normal hum · hold about 2 s
HIGHEST comfortable hum; do not strain · hold about 2 s
WHISTLE home; a relaxed whistle · hold about 2 s

blocks.intro: Room. Stay quiet for 3 seconds (no talking, humming or tapping): this measures the room's noise, like the app's calibration room step.

cells.cue: Stay QUIET for 3 seconds

blocks.intro: One mouth sound per GO. Centre = normal loudness at hand distance (about 25 cm); each prompt names only what differs. A click is one tongue click; a hiss is a short tss (about 0.3 s), or a LONG hiss (about 0.5, 0.7 or 1 s, the cursor-listen sound).

blocks.intro: Remain silent for each 60 second recording.

cells.name: media-30
cells.cue: PLAY a reel or short on phone or laptop speakers at 30%; stay silent for 60 s

cells.name: media-60

cells.name: tv

cells.name: fan
cells.cue: RUN a fan; stay silent for 60 s

cells.name: talk
cells.cue: PLAY people talking (a podcast); stay silent for 60 s

short.about: About 8 minutes, e.g. for a second speaker: the range step, the room step, contours at centre + pitch bottom + loud soft + dist across, click and short hiss at centre + soft + across, long hiss at centre (one rep each), combos at centre x 2; no backgrounds or real checks.
